skins.name: Atelier
skins.description: Design and creative work: a canvas-studio layout in orchid mist, soft studio controls with glass panels, a design-studio nav and fluid motion. Roomy enough to think in.

vars.--fx-grid-areas: "menubar menubar menubar" "nav main inspector" "toolbar toolbar toolbar" "status status status"

skins.name: Clinic
skins.description: Healthcare and service desks: a calm top-portal layout in porcelain whites, large readable type, roomy touch targets and gentle, steady motion. Built for shared screens and long shifts.

skins.name: Control room
skins.description: Operations and monitoring: a command-center layout on deep obsidian, industrial controls, an ops monitor toolbar and alert-first behaviour so changes stand out. Dense, dark and fast.

vars.--fx-grid-areas: "menubar menubar menubar" "toolbar toolbar toolbar" "nav main inspector" "status status status"

skins.name: Ledger
skins.description: Finance and accounting: a dense data grid layout, crisp enterprise controls in slate and steel, precise motion with no flourish, compact type and spacing so more rows fit.

skins.name: Newsroom
skins.description: Editorial and publishing: a document-reader layout in mono paper, Swiss grid controls, reader typography and a review-flow toolbar. Quiet motion keeps the attention on the text.

skins.name: Windows
skins.description: Makes the app look like a Windows 11 program: Segoe UI, Mica colours, a title bar, a menu bar, an Explorer layout, and Windows-style menus, dialogs, buttons and scrollbars, the AmberX outline icon pack, and square-cornered widgets (labels, badges, counters, avatars, progress) through its style parts. It runs inside the browser, so it can't replace the real OS title bar or native pickers such as the file picker. Segoe UI needs a device that has the font.

vars.--fx-font: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
vars.--fx-font-display: 'Segoe UI Variable Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
